meta.name: Verilog Entity
meta.description: A Verilog / SystemVerilog design synthesized to a gate netlist with Yosys; its pins come from the top module's ports

verilog.label: Verilog
verilog.title: The Verilog text and its synthesis

parameters.label: Parameters
parameters.title: Values for the top module's parameters, e.g. W=8, N=2 (decimal integers, names are case-sensitive); empty = the defaults in the text

status.label: Netlist
status.title: What simulates: the netlist of the last synthesis

status.stale: The text changed since the last synthesis; the previous circuit still runs. Synthesize to update it.
status.staleMismatch: The ports changed since the last synthesis; outputs are X until it is synthesized again.
status.failed: The last synthesis failed ({{count}} errors); see the messages.
status.failedRunning: The last synthesis failed ({{count}} errors); the previous circuit still runs.
status.none: Not synthesized yet; outputs are X.
status.broken: The stored netlist cannot be used: {{message}}

editor.synthesizeTitle: Synthesize the text with Yosys (Ctrl+Enter in the editor)
editor.loadTitle: Replace the text with a .v / .sv file
editor.loadFailed: The file could not be read.
editor.messagesOld: Messages of an earlier version of the text
editor.downloadDeclined: Synthesis needs Yosys (a one-time download of about {{size}} MB). Until then the stored netlist of the part simulates.
editor.preview: Ports read from the text: {{inputs}} inputs, {{outputs}} outputs
editor.previewError: Ports cannot be read from the text yet: {{message}}

hdlErrors.verilogMacro: the macro `{{macro}} cannot be read here (macros with arguments and `include are not supported in port and parameter declarations)
hdlErrors.verilogRangeValue: the range of {{name}} cannot be computed from the text (Yosys may still synthesize it)
hdlErrors.verilogPortType_port: port {{port}} has a range on an integer type
hdlErrors.verilogPortType_port_type: the type "{{type}}" of port {{port}} is not supported
hdlErrors.verilogPortDirection: the first port of module {{module}} has no direction
hdlErrors.verilogUnpacked: port {{port}} is an array (unpacked dimension); only packed ranges such as [7:0] are supported
hdlErrors.verilogPortExpression: module {{module}} uses a port expression (.name(...) or {...} in the port list)
hdlErrors.verilogMixedPorts: module {{module}} declares its ports in the header and again in its body
hdlErrors.verilogNotInList: {{port}} is not in the port list of module {{module}}
hdlErrors.verilogNoDirection: port {{port}} of module {{module}} has no input/output declaration
hdlErrors.verilogTopName: the module name {{module}} cannot be passed to Yosys (use a plain name)
hdlErrors.paramLocal: {{name}} is a localparam of module {{module}} and cannot be set
hdlErrors.portWidth: port {{port}} is {{width}} bits in the netlist, {{declared}} declared
hdlErrors.verilogHeader: cannot read the port {{port}} written by Yosys

evo.notSynthesized: the part has no netlist: Logisim-evolution gets its pins with undefined outputs, and it opens here not synthesized
evo.unusable: the stored netlist cannot be used ({{message}}): Logisim-evolution gets the pins with undefined outputs
evo.staleMismatch: the pins changed since the last synthesis: Logisim-evolution gets the pins with undefined outputs; synthesize before exporting
evo.stale: the text changed since the last synthesis: Logisim-evolution gets the netlist of the earlier text; synthesize before exporting
evo.initOne: {{count}} storage cell(s) power up at 1 here; Logisim-evolution starts them at 0
evo.pinsLost: Logisim-evolution reads these pins under another name or width, so they are not wired there: {{names}}
evo.blifOnly: Logisim-evolution has no Verilog component: it opens this part as a BLIF Circuit of the synthesized gates, and drops the Verilog text, parameters and stored netlist when it saves the file
evo.importNoNetlist: the file has no netlist for this Verilog entity; synthesize it to simulate
evo.importNetlistBroken: the stored netlist of this Verilog entity cannot be read; synthesize it again
evo.importNetlistUnusable: the stored netlist of this Verilog entity cannot be used ({{message}}); synthesize it again
evo.importStale: the stored netlist of this Verilog entity is from an earlier version of its text or parameters; it runs until the part is synthesized again
evo.importNoPorts: the ports of this Verilog entity cannot be read; it has no pins until the text is fixed
